definitions.ask: What should `]}` / `[{` do when the active bracket family is links (`n`), which has no `]N` / `[N`?
definitions.why: There is no uppercase link walk to repeat, and a visible no-op never moves the cursor by surprise.

choices.label: Show a short notice and flash the footer; nothing moves, which matches the missing `]N` / `[N`
Open the next / previous link exactly like `]]` / `[[`, so the keys always do something
